versions.name: Wii mini
versions.summary: A smaller version of the Wii with a top-loading disc drive. This version lacks online connectivity, as well as GameCube compatibility and an SD card slot.

versions.name: Starlight Wii Gaming Station
versions.summary: A special version of the Wii which runs games from a hard drive instead of discs, used in hospitals for the entertainment of children. It was previously called Starlight Wii Fun Center.

versions.connectivity: Wi-Fi 802,11 b/g, Bluetooth, USB LAN Adapter
